items.title: Show HN: Clor – The ADE where Claude and Codex work together with shared memory
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Jacob, one of the co-founders of Clor (https://clor.com). Clor is an agentic development environment (ADE) for Claude and Codex with shared memory. Every agent session runs in its own sandbox workspace with its own Git checkout, processes, and dependencies, and all of them share memory, so each one can search every past transcript and read what the others are doing in real time.
Quick demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wDpZBJHsKSk
We built Clor because we were juggling Claude and C

items.title: Show HN: Palestine – JavaScript-like DOM manipulation in Python
items.contentSnippet:
from palestine import Document, Html, Body, Div, Text
doc = Document()
html = Html()
body = Body()
doc.append_child(html)
html.append_child(body)
page = Div(class_="container")
page.append_child(Text("Hello from Palestine"))
body.append_child(page)
print(doc)
